inline.hintMultiline: Enter for a new line; Ctrl+Enter to save.
inline.resetTitle: Go back to the default text?

modules.addHint: Add a section the invitation does not have yet; it opens in its place in the template.
modules.none: Every section is on the invitation.
modules.hidden: {{label}} hidden. Its details are kept; Ctrl+Z or “Add section” brings it back.

categoryChange.title: What should happen to the category texts?

paywall.resetOption: Reset custom texts and publish with my current plan

fields.menuHint: Guests can choose meat / chicken / vegetarian.

publish.done: Your invitation is published! Follow the RSVPs from your dashboard. 🎉
publish.changesDone: Changes published; your guests see the new version.
